title: Afterglow: keep the good weather
subtitle: He can only remember the good parts
intro: Five undeveloped photos hang in the darkroom. Click one and let it light up. The last one is blank.
closing: What the afterglow reaches is only the part he can still remember.

photos.label: New Year
photos.line: Firecrackers go off downstairs. He covers his ears and still hears them.

photos.label: Playing
photos.line: It didn't rain that day. He ran fast and didn't look back.

photos.label: The holiday
photos.line: The table is loud. He remembers not saying much.

photos.label: Back home
photos.line: The road is long. He fell asleep in the back seat and it still wasn't over when he woke.

photos.label: Something bad
photos.line: He tried to recall something bad. The photo is blank.
